evals.name: museum-visitor-2040
evals.prompt: We design visitor experiences for a national museum. Use the futures cone to map futures for museum visiting in 2040 before we write our strategy.
evals.expected_output: Futures classes (projected, probable, plausible, possible, preposterous, preferable) for museum visiting in 2040, with examples per class, a discussion of which futures the current strategy assumes, and what the team prefers and why.

evals.name: urban-mobility-app
evals.prompt: Our urban mobility app team keeps arguing about which futures are realistic. Apply the futures cone to city transport in 2035 so we can have a better conversation.
evals.expected_output: A futures cone for city transport with each class of future illustrated, the projected future named, preposterous futures taken seriously, the preferable future treated as a normative judgement that can sit anywhere, and a way for the team to use it in discussion.

evals.name: pension-provider
evals.prompt: A pension provider asks our studio how members will plan retirement in 2050. Use the futures cone to structure the range of futures we should consider.
evals.expected_output: Futures cone classes applied to retirement planning in 2050, what makes something probable vs plausible vs possible, which futures the provider currently designs for, and preferable futures as a separate judgement.
